(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (transform-code grid code)
      (cond [(= code 1) grid]
            [(= code 2) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= code 3) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= code 4) (transpose grid)]
            [(= code 5) (flip-lr grid)]
            [else (flip-ud grid)]))
    (let* ((code (at g 0 0))
           (clean (set-cell g 0 0 0)))
      (transform-code (crop-to-content clean) code))))
